details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:412-467 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: implement_prepush_test_gate_narrow_allow_list keeps an automation path (`.github/*|.claude/*|scripts/*|prompts/*|workflow-templates/*`) in the repair allow-list whenever it exactly matches a files_touched entry (line 437). It never runs the commit-time `--check-automation-paths` grant check, and when ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS != true it drops only `.github/workflows/` (lines 464-467).
  WHY: The commit-time guard (files_touched_scope_guard.py check_automation_paths; implement_commit_changes.sh:520-524) denies these paths with workflow_edits_disabled or untrusted_author / grant_unavailable. A repair edit the gate allowed therefore makes "Commit changes" refuse the whole implementation with guard=automation-path and latch ai:scope-blocked, which breaks the "the push is never blocked" contract. glm adds that ALLOW_OUT_OF_SCOPE_FILES=true skips the guard call at 428-432 entirely. minimax adds that ci.yml reaches the allow-list through the companion list (prepush_affected_tests.py:444-445). All reviewers that stated a severity rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:428-438 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the guard exits 10/20 (STATUS_SKIP_NO_ALLOWLIST, e.g. a pipeline-authored issue with no files_touched block), `${entries}` stays empty. Line 437 then drops every automation-path extra, even though the commit-time guard would allow them through the open `pipeline_author_no_allowlist` grant.
  WHY: The repair cannot fix a failing test under `scripts/` or `prompts/` (reason=allow_list_narrowed), so the failure reaches PR CI. The narrowing fails closed and never widens scope. sonnet and glm rated this NIT. luna folded it into its combined MAJOR allow-list finding.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:514-571 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The repair editor launch (`codex_thread_reuse.sh direct-run`, lines 514-530) does not set CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_TIMEOUT_SECS, so the turn has no time limit. `editor_reserve=900` (line 571) is used only in the pre-flight budget arithmetic at line 621.
  WHY: An editor turn longer than about 37 minutes hits the step's 60-minute `timeout-minutes` kill partway through the repair. The kill skips revert strays, revert all, restore_symlinks and validate_changed_files_syntax.sh. Because the step has `continue-on-error: true`, "Commit changes" then commits repair edits that were never validated and may fall outside the allow-list. All reviewers that stated a severity rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:281-284 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate forwards only `${CODEX_ISOLATED_IMPLEMENT_ROOT}/work/node_modules`. The node_modules of nested Node projects, which `prepare --deps` / handoff-nested-deps installs at `work/<project>/node_modules`, are never mounted in the source or baseline tree.
  WHY: A nested-project test fails the same way in both trees, gets classified as inherited, and the gate can report pass without the test ever running. A PR-caused failure in that test is hidden. Severity disagreement: luna, qwen and glm rated it MAJOR; sonnet rated it NIT; minimax gave no severity.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:627-648 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a repair is kept but the second gate run is skipped for the step budget, `final` still points at run 1's result.json. The summary (639-645) and the outcome= log line (648) therefore describe the tree as it was before the repair.
  WHY: The PR body reports "Failures caused by this change: N" and status fail for failures the repair may already have fixed. The gate is advisory and fail-open. All reviewers that stated a severity rated it NIT.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:357-370 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: implement_prepush_test_gate_restore_symlinks creates the backup `<path>.prepush-gate-bak` inside the worktree and removes it only after `git checkout HEAD` succeeds.
  WHY: A step kill between the mv and the rm leaves an untracked backup file behind, and "Commit changes" stages it into the AI commit. minimax raised the same issue as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:329-342 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In implement_prepush_test_gate_revert, a failed `git restore` / `git rm` only logs outcome=warning reason=restore_failed. The function still returns success, callers (540-550) ignore the failure, and no durable signal is written.
  WHY: Partial repair edits can stay in the worktree and be committed without anything confirming the rollback. minimax raised the same issue as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:156-167 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The generated summary in ${RUNTIME_DIR}/prepush_test_gate_summary.md states the count of tests run, but does not list the names or file paths of individual tests that passed.
  WHY: The requirement explicitly asks to list "the tests run". The reviewer rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Write `${RUNTIME_DIR}/prepush_test_gate_summary.md`, which states pass / fail / UNVERIFIED, the tests run, PR-caused failures, inherited failures and changed pre-existing assertions." (linked issue #8190, Changes item 2)
  expected_change_site: scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh summary mode of IMPLEMENT_PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_PY (lines 146-171), delegating to write_summary in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:767-790
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The helper passes clean["ran"] to gate.write_summary, but write_summary (prepush_affected_tests.py:772) prints only `len(result.get('ran', []))` ("Tests and checks run: N (selected test files: M)"). Failed and inherited tests are listed by name, but no section names the tests that ran and passed.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:433-438, 464-467 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: implement_prepush_test_gate_narrow_allow_list keeps an automation path on an exact files_touched match without the stricter check_automation_paths check (scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:412-429). When ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS is false it drops only `.github/workflows/`.
  WHY: With ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false or an untrusted author, a repair edit to `scripts/foo.sh` is not rolled back. "Commit changes" then refuses the whole implementation with guard=automation-path and latches ai:scope-blocked.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:431, 437 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: On guard exit 10 (no files_touched block), `${entries}` is empty, so every automation-path extra is dropped despite the open grant `pipeline_author_no_allowlist`.
  WHY: The repair cannot fix tests under `scripts/` or `prompts/`, so they reach PR CI. This fails closed.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:627-629 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a repair is kept and the re-run is skipped for budget, `final="${run1}/result.json"`, so the summary and log report run 1's failures.
  WHY: The PR body reports failures the repair may already have fixed. The gate is advisory.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:514-530, 571 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The repair launch sets no CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_TIMEOUT_SECS, so the editor_reserve (900 s) assumption is never enforced (codex_thread_reuse.sh lines 550-552, 684-686, 722).
  WHY: A step kill partway through the repair skips revert, restore_symlinks and the syntax re-check. Because of continue-on-error, "Commit changes" commits unvalidated edits that may be outside the allow-list.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:281-284 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only the root work/node_modules is forwarded, and nested-project node_modules (scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:461) are not mounted.
  WHY: Nested tests cannot resolve their packages, are classified as inherited, and the gate can report pass. The result is a misleading summary.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:362-370 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The symlink backup `./${path}.prepush-gate-bak` is created in the worktree and removed only after `git checkout` succeeds.
  WHY: A kill between the mv and the rm leaves a stray file that the commit step picks up.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: "Write `${RUNTIME_DIR}/prepush_test_gate_summary.md`, which states pass / fail / UNVERIFIED, the tests run, PR-caused failures, inherited failures and changed pre-existing assertions."
  Expected change site: scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, summary mode of the embedded helper (calls gate.write_summary)
  Evidence of absence: write_summary (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:767-790) prints only `len(result['ran'])`.
- HARDENING (2 related items, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3): add `CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_TIMEOUT_SECS="${editor_reserve:-900}"` to the repair launch (lines 515-530); when ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS != "true", drop every automation-path extra in narrow_allow_list (around line 437).
